import math
import mathutils
import bmesh
import bpy
import random
from typing import Optional

from ...core.base_generator import BaseAssetGenerator
from ...core.materials import MaterialManager
from ...core.mesh_builder import MeshBuilder
from ...core.texture_atlas import PS1TextureAtlas
from .config import CrashCartConfig

class CrashCartGenerator(BaseAssetGenerator[CrashCartConfig]):
    """
    Procedural generator for industrial/medical emergency crash carts.
    Replicates authentic PS1 survival horror props (Below Nominal aesthetic).
    """

    def generate(self, config: CrashCartConfig) -> bpy.types.Object:
        self.clean_context()
        rng = random.Random(config.seed)

        # 1. Setup Material Manager with Wear Level & Seed
        self.material_manager = self.get_material_manager(config)
        mesh_name = f"{config.name}_mesh"
        obj_name = config.name

        if obj_name in bpy.data.objects:
            bpy.data.objects.remove(bpy.data.objects[obj_name], do_unlink=True)
        if mesh_name in bpy.data.meshes:
            bpy.data.meshes.remove(bpy.data.meshes[mesh_name], do_unlink=True)

        mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new(mesh_name)
        obj = bpy.data.objects.new(obj_name, mesh)
        bpy.context.collection.objects.link(obj)

        self.material_manager.assign_to_mesh(obj)
        m_idx = self.material_manager.material_indices
        rgba = {k: self.material_manager.get_rgba(k) for k in self.material_manager.palette.keys()}

        bm = bmesh.new()
        col_layer = bm.loops.layers.color.new("Color")
        uv_layer = bm.loops.layers.uv.new("UVMap")

        # Color preset selection for body
        if config.body_color_preset == "hazard_yellow":
            body_rect = PS1TextureAtlas.get_rect("hazard_stripes")
            body_mat = m_idx.get("hazard_yellow", 0)
            body_rgba = rgba.get("hazard_yellow", (0.85, 0.65, 0.1, 1.0))
        elif config.body_color_preset == "dirty_beige":
            body_rect = PS1TextureAtlas.get_rect("beige_plastic_worn")
            body_mat = m_idx.get("crt_frame", 0)
            body_rgba = rgba.get("crt_frame", (0.7, 0.68, 0.6, 1.0))
        else:
            # Default red emergency
            body_rect = PS1TextureAtlas.get_rect("red_paint_worn")
            body_mat = m_idx.get("casing_red", m_idx.get("door_emergency_red", 0))
            body_rgba = rgba.get("casing_red", (0.6, 0.1, 0.08, 1.0))

        metal_dark_rect = PS1TextureAtlas.get_rect("metal_dark_grime")
        metal_light_rect = PS1TextureAtlas.get_rect("metal_light_brushed")
        rubber_rect = PS1TextureAtlas.get_rect("rubber_black")
        switch_rect = PS1TextureAtlas.get_rect("switch_metal")
        crt_rect = PS1TextureAtlas.get_rect("crt_screen_green" if config.monitor_phosphor_color == "green" else "crt_screen_amber")

        cart_w = config.width
        cart_h = config.height
        cart_d = config.depth
        caster_h = config.caster_height

        # Coordinate System:
        # X: Width (-cart_w/2 to +cart_w/2)
        # Y: Height (0 at floor, +caster_h at bottom of body, +caster_h + cart_h at top)
        # Z: Depth (front is +Z, back is -Z, center is 0)

        body_base_y = caster_h
        body_center_y = body_base_y + (cart_h / 2.0)
        body_top_y = body_base_y + cart_h

        # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
        # 1. Main Cart Chassis Body
        # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
        # Main body box
        MeshBuilder.add_box(
            bm=bm,
            size=mathutils.Vector((cart_w, cart_h, cart_d)),
            offset=mathutils.Vector((0.0, body_center_y, 0.0)),
            mat_idx=body_mat,
            rgba=body_rgba,
            color_layer=col_layer,
            uv_layer=uv_layer,
            uv_rect=body_rect
        )

        # Top surface tray lip / retaining rim (stops supplies from rolling off)
        rim_h = 0.025
        rim_thick = 0.02
        # Back rim
        MeshBuilder.add_box(
            bm=bm,
            size=mathutils.Vector((cart_w, rim_h, rim_thick)),
            offset=mathutils.Vector((0.0, body_top_y + rim_h / 2.0, -cart_d / 2.0 + rim_thick / 2.0)),
            mat_idx=m_idx.get("mounting", 0),
            rgba=rgba.get("mounting", (0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 1.0)),
            color_layer=col_layer,
            uv_layer=uv_layer,
            uv_rect=metal_light_rect
        )
        # Left and Right rims
        for side in (-1.0, 1.0):
            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm=bm,
                size=mathutils.Vector((rim_thick, rim_h, cart_d)),
                offset=mathutils.Vector((side * (cart_w / 2.0 - rim_thick / 2.0), body_top_y + rim_h / 2.0, 0.0)),
                mat_idx=m_idx.get("mounting", 0),
                rgba=rgba.get("mounting", (0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 1.0)),
                color_layer=col_layer,
                uv_layer=uv_layer,
                uv_rect=metal_light_rect
            )

        # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
        # 2. Drawers & Slide Extensions
        # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
        num_drawers = max(1, min(6, config.drawer_count))
        drawer_margin_x = 0.04
        drawer_margin_y = 0.04
        usable_drawer_w = cart_w - (drawer_margin_x * 2.0)
        usable_drawer_h = cart_h - (drawer_margin_y * 2.0)
        each_drawer_h = (usable_drawer_h / num_drawers) - 0.015

        front_z = cart_d / 2.0

        for i in range(num_drawers):
            # i = 0 is top drawer, i = num_drawers - 1 is bottom drawer
            # Calculate Y position
            drawer_y = (body_top_y - drawer_margin_y) - (i + 0.5) * (usable_drawer_h / num_drawers)

            # Slide amount calculation
            if config.drawer_open_mode == "all_closed":
                slide = 0.0
            elif config.drawer_open_mode == "top_open":
                slide = config.drawer_slide_max if i == 0 else 0.0
            elif config.drawer_open_mode == "all_open":
                slide = config.drawer_slide_max * (0.6 + 0.4 * rng.random())
            else:
                # "staggered" (as shown in reference screenshot)
                decay = max(0.0, 1.0 - (i * 0.35))
                slide = config.drawer_slide_max * decay

            drawer_center_z = front_z + slide

            # Drawer front face / block
            drawer_front_depth = 0.025
            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm=bm,
                size=mathutils.Vector((usable_drawer_w, each_drawer_h, drawer_front_depth)),
                offset=mathutils.Vector((0.0, drawer_y, drawer_center_z + drawer_front_depth / 2.0)),
                mat_idx=body_mat,
                rgba=body_rgba,
                color_layer=col_layer,
                uv_layer=uv_layer,
                uv_rect=body_rect
            )

            # If drawer is slid open, generate the drawer box sides and slide runners!
            if slide > 0.015:
                # Drawer interior cavity (sides and floor)
                side_thick = 0.012
                box_d = slide + 0.02
                box_z = front_z + (slide / 2.0)

                # Floor plate
                MeshBuilder.add_box(
                    bm=bm,
                    size=mathutils.Vector((usable_drawer_w - side_thick * 2, side_thick, box_d)),
                    offset=mathutils.Vector((0.0, drawer_y - each_drawer_h / 2.0 + side_thick / 2.0, box_z)),
                    mat_idx=m_idx.get("steel_dark", m_idx.get("casing_inner", 0)),
                    rgba=rgba.get("steel_dark", (0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 1.0)),
                    color_layer=col_layer,
                    uv_layer=uv_layer,
                    uv_rect=metal_dark_rect
                )

                # Left and right drawer sides (sheet metal)
                for side in (-1.0, 1.0):
                    MeshBuilder.add_box(
                        bm=bm,
                        size=mathutils.Vector((side_thick, each_drawer_h * 0.85, box_d)),
                        offset=mathutils.Vector((side * (usable_drawer_w / 2.0 - side_thick / 2.0), drawer_y, box_z)),
                        mat_idx=m_idx.get("mounting", 0),
                        rgba=rgba.get("mounting", (0.35, 0.35, 0.35, 1.0)),
                        color_layer=col_layer,
                        uv_layer=uv_layer,
                        uv_rect=metal_light_rect
                    )

            # Drawer Handle
            handle_z = drawer_center_z + drawer_front_depth + 0.012
            if config.drawer_handle_style == "metal_bar":
                # Horizontal tubular handle
                handle_len = usable_drawer_w * 0.55
                MeshBuilder.add_cylinder(
                    bm=bm,
                    radius=0.009,
                    depth=handle_len,
                    segments=4,
                    offset=mathutils.Vector((0.0, drawer_y, handle_z)),
                    axis='X',
                    mat_idx=m_idx.get("mounting", 0),
                    rgba=rgba.get("mounting", (0.7, 0.7, 0.7, 1.0)),
                    color_layer=col_layer,
                    uv_layer=uv_layer,
                    uv_rect=metal_light_rect,
                    smooth=False
                )
                # Two mounting standoffs
                for post_side in (-1.0, 1.0):
                    MeshBuilder.add_cylinder(
                        bm=bm,
                        radius=0.007,
                        depth=0.018,
                        segments=4,
                        offset=mathutils.Vector((post_side * handle_len * 0.45, drawer_y, handle_z - 0.009)),
                        axis='Z',
                        mat_idx=m_idx.get("mounting", 0),
                        rgba=rgba.get("mounting", (0.7, 0.7, 0.7, 1.0)),
                        color_layer=col_layer,
                        uv_layer=uv_layer,
                        uv_rect=metal_light_rect,
                        smooth=False
                    )
            elif config.drawer_handle_style == "recessed_lip":
                # Recessed metal groove
                MeshBuilder.add_box(
                    bm=bm,
                    size=mathutils.Vector((usable_drawer_w * 0.6, 0.02, 0.012)),
                    offset=mathutils.Vector((0.0, drawer_y + each_drawer_h * 0.25, drawer_center_z + drawer_front_depth)),
                    mat_idx=m_idx.get("steel_dark", m_idx.get("casing_inner", 0)),
                    rgba=rgba.get("steel_dark", (0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 1.0)),
                    color_layer=col_layer,
                    uv_layer=uv_layer,
                    uv_rect=metal_dark_rect
                )

        # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
        # 3. Top Defibrillator / CRT Diagnostic Monitor
        # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
        if config.has_top_monitor:
            mon_w = config.monitor_width
            mon_h = config.monitor_height
            mon_d = config.monitor_depth
            mon_y = body_top_y + (mon_h / 2.0) + rim_h
            mon_z = -cart_d * 0.05  # Slightly set back on top shelf

            # Main monitor housing (beige worn retro casing)
            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm=bm,
                size=mathutils.Vector((mon_w, mon_h, mon_d)),
                offset=mathutils.Vector((0.0, mon_y, mon_z)),
                mat_idx=m_idx.get("crt_frame", 0),
                rgba=rgba.get("crt_frame", (0.72, 0.70, 0.62, 1.0)),
                color_layer=col_layer,
                uv_layer=uv_layer,
                uv_rect=PS1TextureAtlas.get_rect("beige_plastic_worn")
            )

            # CRT screen (left side of monitor face)
            screen_w = mon_w * 0.50
            screen_h = mon_h * 0.65
            screen_x = -mon_w * 0.18
            screen_z = mon_z + (mon_d / 2.0) + 0.008

            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm=bm,
                size=mathutils.Vector((screen_w, screen_h, 0.012)),
                offset=mathutils.Vector((screen_x, mon_y, screen_z)),
                mat_idx=m_idx.get("crt_screen_green", 0),
                rgba=rgba.get("crt_screen_green", (0.15, 0.95, 0.35, 1.0)),
                color_layer=col_layer,
                uv_layer=uv_layer,
                uv_rect=crt_rect
            )

            # Knobs and control dials on the right side of monitor
            if config.has_monitor_knobs:
                knob_x = mon_w * 0.25
                for ki, ky_off in enumerate((-0.035, 0.035)):
                    MeshBuilder.add_cylinder(
                        bm=bm,
                        radius=0.022,
                        depth=0.02,
                        segments=6,
                        offset=mathutils.Vector((knob_x, mon_y + ky_off, screen_z + 0.008)),
                        axis='Z',
                        mat_idx=m_idx.get("switch_metal", 0),
                        rgba=rgba.get("switch_metal", (0.7, 0.7, 0.7, 1.0)),
                        color_layer=col_layer,
                        uv_layer=uv_layer,
                        uv_rect=switch_rect,
                        smooth=False
                    )

            # Top carrying handle for defibrillator
            if config.has_monitor_handle:
                handle_bar_w = mon_w * 0.55
                handle_top_y = mon_y + (mon_h / 2.0) + 0.035
                MeshBuilder.add_cylinder(
                    bm=bm,
                    radius=0.008,
                    depth=handle_bar_w,
                    segments=4,
                    offset=mathutils.Vector((0.0, handle_top_y, mon_z)),
                    axis='X',
                    mat_idx=m_idx.get("mounting", 0),
                    rgba=rgba.get("mounting", (0.7, 0.7, 0.7, 1.0)),
                    color_layer=col_layer,
                    uv_layer=uv_layer,
                    uv_rect=metal_light_rect,
                    smooth=False
                )
                for h_side in (-1.0, 1.0):
                    MeshBuilder.add_cylinder(
                        bm=bm,
                        radius=0.007,
                        depth=0.035,
                        segments=4,
                        offset=mathutils.Vector((h_side * (handle_bar_w / 2.0), handle_top_y - 0.0175, mon_z)),
                        axis='Y',
                        mat_idx=m_idx.get("mounting", 0),
                        rgba=rgba.get("mounting", (0.7, 0.7, 0.7, 1.0)),
                        color_layer=col_layer,
                        uv_layer=uv_layer,
                        uv_rect=metal_light_rect,
                        smooth=False
                    )

        # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
        # 4. Side Push Handle (Hospital/Maintenance Trolley Bar)
        # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
        if config.has_push_handle:
            h_side = -1.0 if config.push_handle_side == "left" else 1.0
            handle_x = h_side * ((cart_w / 2.0) + 0.065)
            handle_y = body_top_y - 0.06
            bar_len = cart_d * 0.75

            # Main horizontal grip bar
            MeshBuilder.add_cylinder(
                bm=bm,
                radius=0.012,
                depth=bar_len,
                segments=4,
                offset=mathutils.Vector((handle_x, handle_y, 0.0)),
                axis='Y',
                mat_idx=m_idx.get("mounting", 0),
                rgba=rgba.get("mounting", (0.75, 0.75, 0.78, 1.0)),
                color_layer=col_layer,
                uv_layer=uv_layer,
                uv_rect=metal_light_rect,
                smooth=False
            )
            # Two support standoffs connecting to cart side
            for z_off in (-bar_len * 0.4, bar_len * 0.4):
                MeshBuilder.add_cylinder(
                    bm=bm,
                    radius=0.009,
                    depth=0.065,
                    segments=4,
                    offset=mathutils.Vector((handle_x - h_side * 0.0325, handle_y, z_off)),
                    axis='X',
                    mat_idx=m_idx.get("mounting", 0),
                    rgba=rgba.get("mounting", (0.75, 0.75, 0.78, 1.0)),
                    color_layer=col_layer,
                    uv_layer=uv_layer,
                    uv_rect=metal_light_rect,
                    smooth=False
                )

        # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
        # 5. Side Oxygen Canister Rack
        # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
        if config.has_oxygen_rack:
            rack_side = 1.0 if config.push_handle_side == "left" else -1.0
            rack_x = rack_side * ((cart_w / 2.0) + 0.08)
            rack_y = body_base_y + (cart_h * 0.4)

            # Bracket cradle
            cradle_w = 0.15
            cradle_d = 0.15
            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm=bm,
                size=mathutils.Vector((0.08, 0.015, cradle_d)),
                offset=mathutils.Vector((rack_x - rack_side * 0.02, body_base_y + 0.08, 0.0)),
                mat_idx=m_idx.get("steel_dark", m_idx.get("mounting", 0)),
                rgba=rgba.get("steel_dark", (0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 1.0)),
                color_layer=col_layer,
                uv_layer=uv_layer,
                uv_rect=metal_dark_rect
            )

            # Oxygen Cylinders
            for ti in range(min(2, config.oxygen_tank_count)):
                tank_z = (ti - 0.5 * (config.oxygen_tank_count - 1)) * 0.12
                tank_rad = 0.05
                tank_h = 0.42
                MeshBuilder.add_cylinder(
                    bm=bm,
                    radius=tank_rad,
                    depth=tank_h,
                    segments=6,
                    offset=mathutils.Vector((rack_x, body_base_y + 0.08 + tank_h / 2.0, tank_z)),
                    axis='Y',
                    mat_idx=m_idx.get("oxygen_cyan", 0),
                    rgba=rgba.get("oxygen_cyan", (0.05, 0.65, 0.75, 1.0)),
                    color_layer=col_layer,
                    uv_layer=uv_layer,
                    uv_rect=PS1TextureAtlas.get_rect("oxygen_cyan_glow"),
                    smooth=False
                )
                # Brass valve on top of canister
                MeshBuilder.add_cylinder(
                    bm=bm,
                    radius=0.018,
                    depth=0.04,
                    segments=4,
                    offset=mathutils.Vector((rack_x, body_base_y + 0.08 + tank_h + 0.02, tank_z)),
                    axis='Y',
                    mat_idx=m_idx.get("switch_metal", 0),
                    rgba=rgba.get("switch_metal", (0.8, 0.7, 0.2, 1.0)),
                    color_layer=col_layer,
                    uv_layer=uv_layer,
                    uv_rect=switch_rect,
                    smooth=False
                )

        # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
        # 6. Swivel Casters / Wheels
        # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
        wheel_r = config.caster_radius
        wheel_thick = 0.028
        inset_x = cart_w * 0.40
        inset_z = cart_d * 0.38

        for corner_x in (-inset_x, inset_x):
            for corner_z in (-inset_z, inset_z):
                # Swivel fork stem (vertical cylinder connecting cart base to wheel axle)
                stem_h = caster_h - wheel_r
                stem_y = caster_h - (stem_h / 2.0)

                # Randomized caster swivel angle (simulates realistic resting position of casters)
                swivel_ang = rng.uniform(0.0, math.pi * 2.0)

                MeshBuilder.add_cylinder(
                    bm=bm,
                    radius=0.014,
                    depth=stem_h,
                    segments=4,
                    offset=mathutils.Vector((corner_x, stem_y, corner_z)),
                    axis='Y',
                    mat_idx=m_idx.get("mounting", 0),
                    rgba=rgba.get("mounting", (0.4, 0.4, 0.4, 1.0)),
                    color_layer=col_layer,
                    uv_layer=uv_layer,
                    uv_rect=metal_light_rect,
                    smooth=False
                )

                # Wheel rubber tire
                wheel_pos = mathutils.Vector((corner_x, wheel_r, corner_z))
                MeshBuilder.add_cylinder(
                    bm=bm,
                    radius=wheel_r,
                    depth=wheel_thick,
                    segments=6,
                    offset=wheel_pos,
                    axis='X',
                    mat_idx=m_idx.get("rubber_tire", 0),
                    rgba=rgba.get("rubber_tire", (0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 1.0)),
                    color_layer=col_layer,
                    uv_layer=uv_layer,
                    uv_rect=rubber_rect,
                    smooth=False
                )

        # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
        # Finalize BMesh and Validate
        # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
        bm.to_mesh(mesh)
        bm.free()

        self.last_generated_object = obj
        return obj

import math
import mathutils
import bmesh
import bpy
import random
from typing import Optional

from ...core.base_generator import BaseAssetGenerator
from ...core.materials import MaterialManager
from ...core.mesh_builder import MeshBuilder
from .config import CrateConfig

class CrateGenerator(BaseAssetGenerator[CrateConfig]):
    """Procedural generator for cargo crates, batteries and chemical containers (PSX low-poly)."""

    def generate(self, config: CrateConfig) -> bpy.types.Object:
        self.clean_context()
        rng = random.Random(config.seed)

        self.material_manager = self.get_material_manager(config)
        mesh_name = f"{config.name}_mesh"
        obj_name = config.name

        if obj_name in bpy.data.objects:
            bpy.data.objects.remove(bpy.data.objects[obj_name], do_unlink=True)
        if mesh_name in bpy.data.meshes:
            bpy.data.meshes.remove(bpy.data.meshes[mesh_name], do_unlink=True)

        mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new(mesh_name)
        obj = bpy.data.objects.new(obj_name, mesh)
        bpy.context.collection.objects.link(obj)

        self.material_manager.assign_to_mesh(obj)
        m_idx = self.material_manager.material_indices
        rgba = {k: self.material_manager.get_rgba(k) for k in self.material_manager.palette.keys()}

        bm = bmesh.new()
        col_layer = bm.loops.layers.color.new("Color")

        w, h, d = config.width, config.height, config.depth

        if config.crate_type == "chemical_drum":
            # --- CHEMICAL DRUM (BARREL) ---
            barrel_rad = min(w, d) / 2.0
            drum_mat = "chemical_barrel_yellow" if config.has_hazard_marking else "chemical_barrel_blue"

            # Main barrel body
            MeshBuilder.add_cylinder(
                bm=bm,
                radius=barrel_rad,
                depth=h,
                segments=7,
                offset=mathutils.Vector((0.0, h / 2.0, 0.0)),
                axis='Y',
                mat_idx=m_idx.get(drum_mat, 0),
                rgba=rgba.get(drum_mat, (0.8, 0.6, 0.1, 1.0)),
                color_layer=col_layer,
                smooth=False
            )

            # Rolling Ribs (chimes) around body
            for chime_y in (h * 0.3, h * 0.7):
                MeshBuilder.add_cylinder(
                    bm=bm,
                    radius=barrel_rad * 1.06,
                    depth=0.035,
                    segments=7,
                    offset=mathutils.Vector((0.0, chime_y, 0.0)),
                    axis='Y',
                    mat_idx=m_idx.get("casing", 0),
                    rgba=rgba.get("casing", (0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 1.0)),
                    color_layer=col_layer,
                    smooth=False
                )

            # Top threaded bung cap
            MeshBuilder.add_cylinder(
                bm=bm,
                radius=0.04,
                depth=0.025,
                segments=6,
                offset=mathutils.Vector((barrel_rad * 0.45, h + 0.012, 0.0)),
                axis='Y',
                mat_idx=m_idx.get("screw", 0),
                rgba=rgba.get("screw", (0.4, 0.4, 0.4, 1.0)),
                color_layer=col_layer,
                smooth=False
            )

        elif config.crate_type == "battery_cell":
            # --- HIGH-VOLTAGE INDUSTRIAL BATTERY ---
            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm=bm,
                size=mathutils.Vector((w, h, d)),
                offset=mathutils.Vector((0.0, h / 2.0, 0.0)),
                mat_idx=m_idx.get("hazard_yellow", 0),
                rgba=rgba.get("hazard_yellow", (0.85, 0.62, 0.08, 1.0)),
                color_layer=col_layer
            )
            # Heavy Black Base Tray
            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm=bm,
                size=mathutils.Vector((w * 1.05, h * 0.2, d * 1.05)),
                offset=mathutils.Vector((0.0, h * 0.1, 0.0)),
                mat_idx=m_idx.get("casing", 0),
                rgba=rgba.get("casing", (0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 1.0)),
                color_layer=col_layer
            )
            # Positive and Negative Terminal Studs on top
            for tx, c_mat in ((-w * 0.28, "button_red"), (w * 0.28, "casing")):
                MeshBuilder.add_cylinder(
                    bm=bm,
                    radius=0.045,
                    depth=0.07,
                    segments=6,
                    offset=mathutils.Vector((tx, h + 0.035, 0.0)),
                    axis='Y',
                    mat_idx=m_idx.get(c_mat, 0),
                    rgba=rgba.get(c_mat, (0.8, 0.2, 0.2, 1.0)),
                    color_layer=col_layer,
                    smooth=False
                )

        elif config.crate_type == "medical_crate":
            # --- EMERGENCY MEDICAL CRATE ---
            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm=bm,
                size=mathutils.Vector((w, h, d)),
                offset=mathutils.Vector((0.0, h / 2.0, 0.0)),
                mat_idx=m_idx.get("casing_inner", 0),
                rgba=rgba.get("casing_inner", (0.8, 0.82, 0.85, 1.0)),
                color_layer=col_layer
            )
            # Red Cross Emblem on Top Lid
            cross_y = h + 0.005
            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm=bm,
                size=mathutils.Vector((w * 0.45, 0.01, d * 0.15)),
                offset=mathutils.Vector((0.0, cross_y, 0.0)),
                mat_idx=m_idx.get("button_red", 0),
                rgba=rgba.get("button_red", (0.9, 0.1, 0.1, 1.0)),
                color_layer=col_layer
            )
            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm=bm,
                size=mathutils.Vector((w * 0.15, 0.01, d * 0.45)),
                offset=mathutils.Vector((0.0, cross_y, 0.0)),
                mat_idx=m_idx.get("button_red", 0),
                rgba=rgba.get("button_red", (0.9, 0.1, 0.1, 1.0)),
                color_layer=col_layer
            )

        else:
            # --- STANDARD CARGO CHEST ---
            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm=bm,
                size=mathutils.Vector((w, h, d)),
                offset=mathutils.Vector((0.0, h / 2.0, 0.0)),
                mat_idx=m_idx.get("casing_inner", 0),
                rgba=rgba.get("casing_inner", (0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 1.0)),
                color_layer=col_layer
            )

            # Lid Rim
            lid_h = h * 0.18
            lid_angle = math.radians(20) if config.lid_state == "ajar_open" else 0.0
            lid_y = h - (lid_h / 2.0) + (math.sin(lid_angle) * (w * 0.2))

            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm=bm,
                size=mathutils.Vector((w * 1.04, lid_h, d * 1.04)),
                offset=mathutils.Vector((0.0, lid_y, 0.0)),
                mat_idx=m_idx.get("casing", 0),
                rgba=rgba.get("casing", (0.15, 0.15, 0.15, 1.0)),
                color_layer=col_layer
            )

            # Stacking Corner Bumpers
            if config.has_reinforced_corners:
                b_size = min(w, h, d) * 0.15
                for sx in (-1.0, 1.0):
                    for sy in (0.0, 1.0):
                        for sz in (-1.0, 1.0):
                            cx = sx * ((w / 2.0) - (b_size / 2.0))
                            cy = (b_size / 2.0) if sy == 0.0 else (h - (b_size / 2.0))
                            cz = sz * ((d / 2.0) - (b_size / 2.0))
                            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                                bm=bm,
                                size=mathutils.Vector((b_size * 1.05, b_size * 1.05, b_size * 1.05)),
                                offset=mathutils.Vector((cx, cy, cz)),
                                mat_idx=m_idx.get("mounting", 0),
                                rgba=rgba.get("mounting", (0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 1.0)),
                                color_layer=col_layer
                            )

            # Side Handles
            if config.has_handles:
                for side in (-1.0, 1.0):
                    hx = side * ((w / 2.0) + 0.02)
                    MeshBuilder.add_box(
                        bm=bm,
                        size=mathutils.Vector((0.04, 0.05, d * 0.35)),
                        offset=mathutils.Vector((hx, h * 0.6, 0.0)),
                        mat_idx=m_idx.get("screw", 0),
                        rgba=rgba.get("screw", (0.4, 0.4, 0.4, 1.0)),
                        color_layer=col_layer
                    )

            # Front Latch Clasps
            if config.has_latches:
                for lx in (-w * 0.25, w * 0.25):
                    MeshBuilder.add_box(
                        bm=bm,
                        size=mathutils.Vector((0.04, 0.08, 0.025)),
                        offset=mathutils.Vector((lx, h * 0.78, (d / 2.0) + 0.015)),
                        mat_idx=m_idx.get("switch_metal", 0),
                        rgba=rgba.get("switch_metal", (0.7, 0.7, 0.7, 1.0)),
                        color_layer=col_layer
                    )

        bm.to_mesh(mesh)
        bm.free()
        mesh.update()
        return obj

import math
import mathutils
import bmesh
import bpy

from ...core.base_generator import BaseAssetGenerator, ValidationReport
from ...core.mesh_builder import MeshBuilder
from ...core.materials import MaterialManager
from .config import CrewBedConfig

class CrewBedGenerator(BaseAssetGenerator):
    """Procedural generator for PSX-style station beds, cots, and infirmary gurneys."""

    def generate(self, config: CrewBedConfig) -> bpy.types.Object:
        mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new(name=f"{config.name}_mesh")
        obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name=config.name, object_data=mesh)
        bpy.context.collection.objects.link(obj)

        mat_mgr = self.get_material_manager(config)
        mat_mgr.assign_to_mesh(obj)

        bm = bmesh.new()
        color_layer = bm.loops.layers.color.new("Col")
        uv_layer = bm.loops.layers.uv.new("UVMap")

        w = config.width
        l = config.length
        h = config.height
        half_w = w * 0.5
        half_l = l * 0.5

        # Materials
        m_frame = mat_mgr.get_index("wall_support_beam")
        r_frame = mat_mgr.get_rect("metal_light_brushed")

        m_dark = mat_mgr.get_index("wall_bulkhead")
        r_dark = mat_mgr.get_rect("metal_dark_grime")

        m_mattress = mat_mgr.get_index("mat_casing")
        r_mattress = mat_mgr.get_rect("beige_plastic_worn")

        # Blanket color
        if config.blanket_color == "medical_blue":
            m_blanket = mat_mgr.get_index("chemical_barrel_blue")
            r_blanket = mat_mgr.get_rect("button_blue")
            blanket_rgba = (0.15, 0.35, 0.55, 1.0)
        elif config.blanket_color == "emergency_orange":
            m_blanket = mat_mgr.get_index("hazard_yellow")
            r_blanket = mat_mgr.get_rect("hazard_stripes")
            blanket_rgba = (0.85, 0.55, 0.10, 1.0)
        elif config.blanket_color == "brown_wool":
            m_blanket = mat_mgr.get_index("chair_vinyl")
            r_blanket = mat_mgr.get_rect("chair_vinyl_dark")
            blanket_rgba = (0.28, 0.22, 0.18, 1.0)
        else: # station_gray
            m_blanket = mat_mgr.get_index("locker_gray")
            r_blanket = mat_mgr.get_rect("metal_dark_grime")
            blanket_rgba = (0.35, 0.37, 0.40, 1.0)

        m_pillow = mat_mgr.get_index("button_gray")
        r_pillow = mat_mgr.get_rect("beige_plastic_worn")

        m_stain = mat_mgr.get_index("rust_patch")
        r_stain = mat_mgr.get_rect("rust_heavy")

        m_rubber = mat_mgr.get_index("rubber_tire")
        r_rubber = mat_mgr.get_rect("rubber_black")

        frame_h = h * 0.55
        mattress_thick = 0.16

        # -------------------------------------------------------------
        # 1. BED FRAME & LEGS
        # -------------------------------------------------------------
        if config.bed_type == "enclosed_pod":
            # Solid boxy bulkhead pod frame with headboard and footboard
            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm,
                size=mathutils.Vector((w + 0.08, l + 0.12, frame_h)),
                offset=mathutils.Vector((0.0, 0.0, frame_h * 0.5)),
                mat_idx=m_dark,
                uv_layer=uv_layer,
                uv_rect=r_dark,
                color_layer=color_layer,
                rgba=(0.22, 0.24, 0.26, 1.0)
            )
            # Tall Headboard
            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm,
                size=mathutils.Vector((w + 0.08, 0.12, h + 0.35)),
                offset=mathutils.Vector((0.0, half_l + 0.06, (h + 0.35) * 0.5)),
                mat_idx=m_frame,
                uv_layer=uv_layer,
                uv_rect=r_frame,
                color_layer=color_layer,
                rgba=(0.32, 0.35, 0.38, 1.0)
            )
            # Footboard
            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm,
                size=mathutils.Vector((w + 0.08, 0.08, h + 0.10)),
                offset=mathutils.Vector((0.0, -half_l - 0.04, (h + 0.10) * 0.5)),
                mat_idx=m_frame,
                uv_layer=uv_layer,
                uv_rect=r_frame,
                color_layer=color_layer
            )

        elif config.bed_type == "medical_gurney":
            # Central pedestal with wheels and scissor struts
            pedestal_w = w * 0.55
            pedestal_l = l * 0.70
            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm,
                size=mathutils.Vector((pedestal_w, pedestal_l, 0.08)),
                offset=mathutils.Vector((0.0, 0.0, 0.14)),
                mat_idx=m_dark,
                uv_layer=uv_layer,
                uv_rect=r_dark,
                color_layer=color_layer
            )
            # Hydraulic central column
            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm,
                size=mathutils.Vector((0.25, 0.40, frame_h - 0.14)),
                offset=mathutils.Vector((0.0, 0.0, 0.14 + (frame_h - 0.14) * 0.5)),
                mat_idx=m_frame,
                uv_layer=uv_layer,
                uv_rect=r_frame,
                color_layer=color_layer
            )
            # 4 Caster Wheels
            wheel_rad = 0.06
            for cx in [-pedestal_w * 0.42, pedestal_w * 0.42]:
                for cy in [-pedestal_l * 0.42, pedestal_l * 0.42]:
                    MeshBuilder.add_cylinder(
                        bm,
                        radius=wheel_rad,
                        depth=0.04,
                        segments=6,
                        offset=mathutils.Vector((cx, cy, wheel_rad)),
                        axis='X',
                        mat_idx=m_rubber,
                        uv_layer=uv_layer,
                        uv_rect=r_rubber,
                        color_layer=color_layer
                    )
            # Mattress pan
            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm,
                size=mathutils.Vector((w + 0.04, l + 0.04, 0.06)),
                offset=mathutils.Vector((0.0, 0.0, frame_h + 0.03)),
                mat_idx=m_frame,
                uv_layer=uv_layer,
                uv_rect=r_frame,
                color_layer=color_layer
            )

        else: # crew_cot (tubular steel 4-legged cot)
            leg_thick = 0.045
            for lx in [-half_w + 0.03, half_w - 0.03]:
                for ly in [-half_l + 0.03, half_l - 0.03]:
                    MeshBuilder.add_box(
                        bm,
                        size=mathutils.Vector((leg_thick, leg_thick, frame_h)),
                        offset=mathutils.Vector((lx, ly, frame_h * 0.5)),
                        mat_idx=m_frame,
                        uv_layer=uv_layer,
                        uv_rect=r_frame,
                        color_layer=color_layer
                    )
            # Longitudinal side rails
            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm,
                size=mathutils.Vector((leg_thick, l, 0.06)),
                offset=mathutils.Vector((-half_w + 0.03, 0.0, frame_h - 0.03)),
                mat_idx=m_frame,
                uv_layer=uv_layer,
                uv_rect=r_frame,
                color_layer=color_layer
            )
            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm,
                size=mathutils.Vector((leg_thick, l, 0.06)),
                offset=mathutils.Vector((half_w - 0.03, 0.0, frame_h - 0.03)),
                mat_idx=m_frame,
                uv_layer=uv_layer,
                uv_rect=r_frame,
                color_layer=color_layer
            )
            # Headboard & Footboard arches
            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm,
                size=mathutils.Vector((w, leg_thick, 0.35)),
                offset=mathutils.Vector((0.0, half_l - 0.03, frame_h + 0.14)),
                mat_idx=m_frame,
                uv_layer=uv_layer,
                uv_rect=r_frame,
                color_layer=color_layer
            )
            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm,
                size=mathutils.Vector((w, leg_thick, 0.20)),
                offset=mathutils.Vector((0.0, -half_l + 0.03, frame_h + 0.08)),
                mat_idx=m_frame,
                uv_layer=uv_layer,
                uv_rect=r_frame,
                color_layer=color_layer
            )

        # Under-bed drawers
        if config.has_under_drawers and config.bed_type != "medical_gurney":
            drw_w = w * 0.82
            drw_l = l * 0.38
            drw_h = frame_h * 0.70
            for dy in [-l * 0.22, l * 0.22]:
                MeshBuilder.add_box(
                    bm,
                    size=mathutils.Vector((drw_w, drw_l, drw_h)),
                    offset=mathutils.Vector((0.0, dy, drw_h * 0.5 + 0.02)),
                    mat_idx=m_dark,
                    uv_layer=uv_layer,
                    uv_rect=r_dark,
                    color_layer=color_layer,
                    rgba=(0.28, 0.30, 0.32, 1.0)
                )
                # Recessed handle lip
                MeshBuilder.add_box(
                    bm,
                    size=mathutils.Vector((0.02, 0.20, 0.04)),
                    offset=mathutils.Vector((-drw_w * 0.5 - 0.01, dy, drw_h * 0.65)),
                    mat_idx=m_frame,
                    uv_layer=uv_layer,
                    uv_rect=r_frame,
                    color_layer=color_layer
                )

        # -------------------------------------------------------------
        # 2. MATTRESS
        # -------------------------------------------------------------
        mat_z = frame_h + mattress_thick * 0.5
        if config.headrest_incline > 1.0:
            # Split mattress: lower 2/3 flat, upper 1/3 inclined
            flat_l = l * 0.65
            head_l = l * 0.35
            # Flat part
            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm,
                size=mathutils.Vector((w * 0.94, flat_l, mattress_thick)),
                offset=mathutils.Vector((0.0, -half_l + flat_l * 0.5, mat_z)),
                mat_idx=m_mattress,
                uv_layer=uv_layer,
                uv_rect=r_mattress,
                color_layer=color_layer,
                rgba=(0.60, 0.58, 0.52, 1.0)
            )
            # Inclined head part
            inc_rad = math.radians(min(45.0, config.headrest_incline))
            head_z_lift = math.sin(inc_rad) * (head_l * 0.5)
            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm,
                size=mathutils.Vector((w * 0.94, head_l, mattress_thick)),
                offset=mathutils.Vector((0.0, half_l - head_l * 0.5, mat_z + head_z_lift)),
                mat_idx=m_mattress,
                uv_layer=uv_layer,
                uv_rect=r_mattress,
                color_layer=color_layer,
                rgba=(0.60, 0.58, 0.52, 1.0)
            )
        else:
            # Full flat mattress
            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm,
                size=mathutils.Vector((w * 0.94, l * 0.96, mattress_thick)),
                offset=mathutils.Vector((0.0, 0.0, mat_z)),
                mat_idx=m_mattress,
                uv_layer=uv_layer,
                uv_rect=r_mattress,
                color_layer=color_layer,
                rgba=(0.60, 0.58, 0.52, 1.0)
            )

        # -------------------------------------------------------------
        # 3. BEDDING, BLANKET & PILLOW
        # -------------------------------------------------------------
        top_z = frame_h + mattress_thick

        if config.mattress_state == "made_clean":
            # Neatly tucked blanket covering lower 70% of bed
            b_len = l * 0.72
            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm,
                size=mathutils.Vector((w * 0.96, b_len, 0.03)),
                offset=mathutils.Vector((0.0, -half_l + b_len * 0.5, top_z + 0.015)),
                mat_idx=m_blanket,
                uv_layer=uv_layer,
                uv_rect=r_blanket,
                color_layer=color_layer,
                rgba=blanket_rgba
            )
            # Folded sheet cuff
            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm,
                size=mathutils.Vector((w * 0.96, 0.12, 0.035)),
                offset=mathutils.Vector((0.0, -half_l + b_len, top_z + 0.017)),
                mat_idx=m_pillow,
                uv_layer=uv_layer,
                uv_rect=r_pillow,
                color_layer=color_layer,
                rgba=(0.75, 0.75, 0.72, 1.0)
            )

        elif config.mattress_state == "rumpled_disheveled":
            # Disordered bunched blanket thrown across the middle
            b_len = l * 0.50
            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm,
                size=mathutils.Vector((w * 0.85, b_len, 0.06)),
                offset=mathutils.Vector((0.05, -0.15, top_z + 0.03)),
                mat_idx=m_blanket,
                uv_layer=uv_layer,
                uv_rect=r_blanket,
                color_layer=color_layer,
                rgba=blanket_rgba
            )
            # Second bunched fold
            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm,
                size=mathutils.Vector((w * 0.55, 0.35, 0.08)),
                offset=mathutils.Vector((-0.10, -0.35, top_z + 0.05)),
                mat_idx=m_blanket,
                uv_layer=uv_layer,
                uv_rect=r_blanket,
                color_layer=color_layer,
                rgba=blanket_rgba
            )

        elif config.mattress_state == "bare_foam_stained":
            # Dark grim/blood stain on bare foam
            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm,
                size=mathutils.Vector((w * 0.45, 0.65, 0.005)),
                offset=mathutils.Vector((0.05, 0.10, top_z + 0.002)),
                mat_idx=m_stain,
                uv_layer=uv_layer,
                uv_rect=r_stain,
                color_layer=color_layer,
                rgba=(0.45, 0.15, 0.10, 1.0)
            )

        # Pillow
        if config.has_pillow:
            p_len = 0.38
            p_width = w * 0.75
            p_thick = 0.09
            p_y = half_l - p_len * 0.5 - 0.06
            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm,
                size=mathutils.Vector((p_width, p_len, p_thick)),
                offset=mathutils.Vector((0.0, p_y, top_z + p_thick * 0.5)),
                mat_idx=m_pillow,
                uv_layer=uv_layer,
                uv_rect=r_pillow,
                color_layer=color_layer,
                rgba=(0.78, 0.78, 0.75, 1.0)
            )

        # Side Guardrails
        if config.has_guardrails or config.bed_type == "medical_gurney":
            rail_l = l * 0.65
            rail_h = 0.22
            rail_thick = 0.025
            for rx in [-half_w - 0.015, half_w + 0.015]:
                # Top rail
                MeshBuilder.add_box(
                    bm,
                    size=mathutils.Vector((rail_thick, rail_l, rail_thick)),
                    offset=mathutils.Vector((rx, 0.0, top_z + rail_h)),
                    mat_idx=m_frame,
                    uv_layer=uv_layer,
                    uv_rect=r_frame,
                    color_layer=color_layer
                )
                # Vertical uprights
                for ry in [-rail_l * 0.42, 0.0, rail_l * 0.42]:
                    MeshBuilder.add_box(
                        bm,
                        size=mathutils.Vector((rail_thick, rail_thick, rail_h)),
                        offset=mathutils.Vector((rx, ry, top_z + rail_h * 0.5)),
                        mat_idx=m_frame,
                        uv_layer=uv_layer,
                        uv_rect=r_frame,
                        color_layer=color_layer
                    )

        bm.to_mesh(mesh)
        bm.free()
        mesh.update()
        return obj

    def validate(self, obj: bpy.types.Object, config: CrewBedConfig) -> ValidationReport:
        return super().validate(obj, config)

import math
import mathutils
import bpy
import bmesh
from ...core.base_generator import BaseAssetGenerator
from ...core.mesh_builder import MeshBuilder
from ...core.texture_atlas import PS1TextureAtlas
from .config import CryoStasisPodConfig

class CryoStasisPodGenerator(BaseAssetGenerator[CryoStasisPodConfig]):
    """
    Procedural generator for Cryo Stasis Pod:
    Industrial retrofuturistic cryo-preservation chamber with heavy steel hatch,
    inspection window, cooling conduits, and life support readouts.
    """

    def generate(self, config: CryoStasisPodConfig = None) -> bpy.types.Object:
        if config is not None:
            self.config = config
        self.clean_context()
        self.material_manager = self.get_material_manager(self.config)
        MeshBuilder.set_active_material_manager(self.material_manager)

        obj, bm = self.create_mesh_object(self.config.name)
        self.material_manager.assign_to_mesh(obj)
        m_idx = self.material_manager.material_indices

        uv_layer = MeshBuilder.get_or_create_uv_layer(bm)
        col_layer = MeshBuilder.get_or_create_color_layer(bm)

        h = self.config.height
        w = self.config.width
        d = self.config.depth

        casing_mat = m_idx.get("casing", 0)
        metal_mat = m_idx.get("dark_metal", m_idx.get("casing", 0))
        glass_mat = m_idx.get("glass", m_idx.get("casing", 0))
        screen_mat = m_idx.get("screen", m_idx.get("casing", 0))
        pipe_mat = m_idx.get("pipe", m_idx.get("casing", 0))
        brass_mat = m_idx.get("brass", m_idx.get("casing", 0))

        casing_rgba = self.material_manager.get_rgba("casing")
        metal_rgba = self.material_manager.get_rgba("dark_metal")
        glass_rgba = (0.35, 0.65, 0.75, 0.85) if self.config.pod_state != "offline" else (0.2, 0.25, 0.25, 0.9)
        screen_rgba = (0.1, 0.8, 0.3, 1.0) if self.config.pod_state != "offline" else (0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 1.0)

        # 1. Base pedestal (heavy octagonal foundation plate)
        base_h = 0.15
        MeshBuilder.add_box(
            bm,
            size=(w * 1.1, d * 1.1, base_h),
            offset=(0.0, 0.0, base_h / 2.0),
            mat_idx=metal_mat,
            rgba=metal_rgba,
            uv_rect=PS1TextureAtlas.get_rect("metal_dark_grime")
        )

        # 2. Main vertical chamber shell (rear and side enclosure)
        chamber_h = h - base_h - 0.2
        chamber_z = base_h + chamber_h / 2.0
        wall_t = 0.1

        # Rear back wall
        MeshBuilder.add_box(
            bm,
            size=(w, wall_t, chamber_h),
            offset=(0.0, -d / 2.0 + wall_t / 2.0, chamber_z),
            mat_idx=casing_mat,
            rgba=casing_rgba,
            uv_rect=PS1TextureAtlas.get_rect("painted_metal_white")
        )

        # Left and Right walls
        side_d = d - wall_t
        for sx in (-1, 1):
            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm,
                size=(wall_t, side_d, chamber_h),
                offset=(sx * (w / 2.0 - wall_t / 2.0), -wall_t / 2.0, chamber_z),
                mat_idx=casing_mat,
                rgba=casing_rgba,
                uv_rect=PS1TextureAtlas.get_rect("painted_metal_white")
            )

        # Interior rear padding / stasis cradle
        MeshBuilder.add_box(
            bm,
            size=(w * 0.7, 0.06, chamber_h * 0.88),
            offset=(0.0, -d / 2.0 + wall_t + 0.03, chamber_z),
            mat_idx=metal_mat,
            rgba=(0.18, 0.20, 0.22, 1.0),
            uv_rect=PS1TextureAtlas.get_rect("chair_vinyl_dark")
        )

        # Occupant cocoon silhouette (if occupied)
        if self.config.pod_state == "occupied":
            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm,
                size=(w * 0.45, d * 0.35, chamber_h * 0.72),
                offset=(0.0, -0.05, chamber_z - 0.05),
                mat_idx=metal_mat,
                rgba=(0.12, 0.15, 0.18, 1.0),
                uv_rect=PS1TextureAtlas.get_rect("rubber_black")
            )

        # Top cap manifold
        cap_h = 0.2
        cap_z = base_h + chamber_h + cap_h / 2.0
        MeshBuilder.add_box(
            bm,
            size=(w * 1.08, d * 1.08, cap_h),
            offset=(0.0, 0.0, cap_z),
            mat_idx=casing_mat,
            rgba=casing_rgba,
            uv_rect=PS1TextureAtlas.get_rect("metal_dark_grime")
        )

        # Top warning beacon / stasis status ring
        beacon_rect = PS1TextureAtlas.get_rect("oxygen_cyan_glow") if self.config.pod_state != "offline" else PS1TextureAtlas.get_rect("crt_screen_off")
        MeshBuilder.add_cylinder(
            bm,
            radius=w * 0.22,
            depth=0.08,
            segments=8,
            offset=(0.0, 0.0, h + 0.04),
            axis='Z',
            mat_idx=screen_mat,
            rgba=screen_rgba,
            uv_rect=beacon_rect
        )

        # 3. Front door hatch with hinge rotation
        angle_rad = math.radians(self.config.door_open_angle)
        door_w = w * 0.96
        door_h = chamber_h * 0.98
        door_t = 0.09
        hinge_x = -w / 2.0 + wall_t / 2.0
        hinge_y = d / 2.0 - door_t / 2.0

        # Construct door frame relative to hinge
        # When angle == 0, door center is at (0, hinge_y, chamber_z)
        door_rot = mathutils.Euler((0.0, 0.0, -angle_rad), 'XYZ')
        
        # Local vector from hinge to door center
        local_door_offset = mathutils.Vector((w / 2.0 - wall_t / 2.0, 0.0, 0.0))
        rotated_door_offset = door_rot.to_matrix() @ local_door_offset
        door_center = mathutils.Vector((hinge_x, hinge_y, chamber_z)) + rotated_door_offset

        # Door outer body
        door_geom = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        d_verts = [v for v in door_geom["verts"] if isinstance(v, bmesh.types.BMVert)]
        for v in d_verts:
            # Scale locally
            v.co.x *= door_w
            v.co.y *= door_t
            v.co.z *= door_h
            # Rotate around Z by -angle_rad
            v.co = door_rot.to_matrix() @ v.co
            # Translate to door center
            v.co += door_center

        for f in bm.faces:
            if all(v in d_verts for v in f.verts):
                MeshBuilder.apply_face_attributes(f, casing_mat, casing_rgba, col_layer)
                MeshBuilder.apply_box_face_uv(f, uv_layer, PS1TextureAtlas.get_rect("painted_metal_white"))

        # Inspection window on door
        win_w = door_w * 0.4
        win_h = door_h * 0.55
        win_geom = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        w_verts = [v for v in win_geom["verts"] if isinstance(v, bmesh.types.BMVert)]
        for v in w_verts:
            v.co.x *= win_w
            v.co.y *= door_t * 1.15
            v.co.z *= win_h
            v.co = door_rot.to_matrix() @ v.co
            v.co += door_center + door_rot.to_matrix() @ mathutils.Vector((0.0, 0.0, chamber_h * 0.08))

        frost_rect = PS1TextureAtlas.get_rect("glass_reinforced") if self.config.frost_level < 0.6 else PS1TextureAtlas.get_rect("oxygen_cyan_glow")
        for f in bm.faces:
            if all(v in w_verts for v in f.verts):
                MeshBuilder.apply_face_attributes(f, glass_mat, glass_rgba, col_layer)
                MeshBuilder.apply_face_uv_rect(f, uv_layer, frost_rect)

        # 4. Cryo pipes on side
        if self.config.has_cryo_pipes:
            pipe_x = w / 2.0 + 0.04
            MeshBuilder.add_cylinder(
                bm,
                radius=0.035,
                depth=chamber_h * 0.9,
                segments=6,
                offset=(pipe_x, -d * 0.15, chamber_z),
                axis='Z',
                mat_idx=pipe_mat,
                rgba=(0.35, 0.40, 0.45, 1.0),
                uv_rect=PS1TextureAtlas.get_rect("metal_dark_grime")
            )
            MeshBuilder.add_cylinder(
                bm,
                radius=0.025,
                depth=chamber_h * 0.85,
                segments=6,
                offset=(pipe_x, d * 0.15, chamber_z),
                axis='Z',
                mat_idx=brass_mat,
                rgba=(0.75, 0.65, 0.25, 1.0),
                uv_rect=PS1TextureAtlas.get_rect("cartridge_amber")
            )

        # 5. Side status monitor
        if self.config.has_status_monitor:
            mon_x = -(w / 2.0 + 0.05)
            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm,
                size=(0.08, 0.25, 0.35),
                offset=(mon_x, 0.0, chamber_z + 0.2),
                mat_idx=metal_mat,
                rgba=metal_rgba,
                uv_rect=PS1TextureAtlas.get_rect("metal_dark_grime")
            )
            # Screen face
            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm,
                size=(0.01, 0.20, 0.28),
                offset=(mon_x - 0.04, 0.0, chamber_z + 0.2),
                mat_idx=screen_mat,
                rgba=screen_rgba,
                uv_rect=PS1TextureAtlas.get_rect("crt_screen_green")
            )

        self.finalize_mesh(obj, bm)
        self.compact_materials(obj)
        return obj

import math
import mathutils
import bpy
import bmesh
from ...core.base_generator import BaseAssetGenerator
from ...core.mesh_builder import MeshBuilder
from ...core.texture_atlas import PS1TextureAtlas
from .config import DeconChamberConfig

class DeconChamberGenerator(BaseAssetGenerator[DeconChamberConfig]):
    """
    Procedural generator for Decon Chamber:
    Chemical decontamination shower booth with multiple spray nozzle tiers,
    deluge ceiling head, floor sump grate, and external cycle status console.
    """

    def generate(self, config: DeconChamberConfig = None) -> bpy.types.Object:
        if config is not None:
            self.config = config
        self.clean_context()
        self.material_manager = self.get_material_manager(self.config)
        MeshBuilder.set_active_material_manager(self.material_manager)

        obj, bm = self.create_mesh_object(self.config.name)
        self.material_manager.assign_to_mesh(obj)
        m_idx = self.material_manager.material_indices

        uv_layer = MeshBuilder.get_or_create_uv_layer(bm)
        col_layer = MeshBuilder.get_or_create_color_layer(bm)

        w = self.config.chamber_width
        d = self.config.chamber_depth
        h = self.config.chamber_height

        casing_mat = m_idx.get("casing", 0)
        metal_mat = m_idx.get("dark_metal", m_idx.get("casing", 0))
        glass_mat = m_idx.get("glass", m_idx.get("casing", 0))
        pipe_mat = m_idx.get("pipe", m_idx.get("casing", 0))
        brass_mat = m_idx.get("brass", m_idx.get("casing", 0))
        screen_mat = m_idx.get("screen", m_idx.get("casing", 0))

        casing_rgba = self.material_manager.get_rgba("casing")
        metal_rgba = self.material_manager.get_rgba("dark_metal")
        glass_rgba = (0.35, 0.65, 0.75, 0.75)

        wall_t = 0.08
        base_h = 0.14

        # 1. Base drainage sump & walking grating
        MeshBuilder.add_box(
            bm,
            size=(w, d, base_h),
            offset=(0.0, 0.0, base_h / 2.0),
            mat_idx=metal_mat,
            rgba=metal_rgba,
            uv_rect=PS1TextureAtlas.get_rect("metal_dark_grime")
        )
        MeshBuilder.add_box(
            bm,
            size=(w * 0.75, d * 0.75, 0.02),
            offset=(0.0, 0.0, base_h + 0.01),
            mat_idx=metal_mat,
            rgba=(0.25, 0.25, 0.28, 1.0),
            uv_rect=PS1TextureAtlas.get_rect("vent_grill")
        )

        cabin_h = h - base_h - 0.16
        cabin_z = base_h + cabin_h / 2.0

        # 2. Back and side walls
        # Back wall
        MeshBuilder.add_box(
            bm,
            size=(w, wall_t, cabin_h),
            offset=(0.0, -d / 2.0 + wall_t / 2.0, cabin_z),
            mat_idx=casing_mat,
            rgba=casing_rgba,
            uv_rect=PS1TextureAtlas.get_rect("ceramic_tile_white")
        )

        # Left and Right walls
        for sx in (-1, 1):
            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm,
                size=(wall_t, d - wall_t, cabin_h),
                offset=(sx * (w / 2.0 - wall_t / 2.0), wall_t / 2.0, cabin_z),
                mat_idx=casing_mat,
                rgba=casing_rgba,
                uv_rect=PS1TextureAtlas.get_rect("ceramic_tile_white")
            )

        # 3. Top roof ceiling slab & deluge shower head
        roof_h = 0.16
        roof_z = base_h + cabin_h + roof_h / 2.0
        MeshBuilder.add_box(
            bm,
            size=(w * 1.04, d * 1.04, roof_h),
            offset=(0.0, 0.0, roof_z),
            mat_idx=metal_mat,
            rgba=metal_rgba,
            uv_rect=PS1TextureAtlas.get_rect("metal_dark_grime")
        )

        if self.config.has_ceiling_shower_head:
            # Ceiling shower rose head
            MeshBuilder.add_cylinder(
                bm,
                radius=0.14,
                depth=0.06,
                segments=8,
                offset=(0.0, 0.0, base_h + cabin_h - 0.03),
                axis='Z',
                mat_idx=metal_mat,
                rgba=(0.8, 0.82, 0.85, 1.0),
                uv_rect=PS1TextureAtlas.get_rect("metal_light_brushed")
            )

        # 4. Vertical corner chemical pipes & spray nozzles
        tiers = max(2, min(4, int(self.config.nozzle_tiers)))
        for sx in (-1, 1):
            pipe_x = sx * (w / 2.0 - wall_t - 0.06)
            pipe_y = -d / 2.0 + wall_t + 0.06
            # Vertical manifold pipe
            MeshBuilder.add_cylinder(
                bm,
                radius=0.02,
                depth=cabin_h * 0.9,
                segments=6,
                offset=(pipe_x, pipe_y, cabin_z),
                axis='Z',
                mat_idx=pipe_mat,
                rgba=(0.4, 0.45, 0.5, 1.0),
                uv_rect=PS1TextureAtlas.get_rect("metal_dark_grime")
            )

            # Spray nozzles at each height tier
            for t in range(tiers):
                nz_z = base_h + 0.35 + t * (cabin_h * 0.75 / float(tiers))
                MeshBuilder.add_cylinder(
                    bm,
                    radius=0.015,
                    depth=0.06,
                    segments=4,
                    offset=(pipe_x - sx * 0.03, pipe_y + 0.03, nz_z),
                    axis='X',
                    mat_idx=brass_mat,
                    rgba=(0.85, 0.68, 0.22, 1.0),
                    uv_rect=PS1TextureAtlas.get_rect("cartridge_amber")
                )

        # 5. Front door hatch with hinge rotation
        angle_rad = math.radians(self.config.door_open_angle)
        door_w = w * 0.88
        door_h = cabin_h * 0.96
        door_t = 0.06
        hinge_x = -w / 2.0 + wall_t
        hinge_y = d / 2.0 - door_t / 2.0

        door_rot = mathutils.Euler((0.0, 0.0, -angle_rad), 'XYZ')
        local_door_offset = mathutils.Vector((door_w / 2.0, 0.0, 0.0))
        rotated_door_offset = door_rot.to_matrix() @ local_door_offset
        door_center = mathutils.Vector((hinge_x, hinge_y, cabin_z)) + rotated_door_offset

        # Door frame
        door_geom = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        d_verts = [v for v in door_geom["verts"] if isinstance(v, bmesh.types.BMVert)]
        for v in d_verts:
            v.co.x *= door_w
            v.co.y *= door_t
            v.co.z *= door_h
            v.co = door_rot.to_matrix() @ v.co
            v.co += door_center

        for f in bm.faces:
            if all(v in d_verts for v in f.verts):
                MeshBuilder.apply_face_attributes(f, casing_mat, casing_rgba, col_layer)
                MeshBuilder.apply_box_face_uv(f, uv_layer, PS1TextureAtlas.get_rect("painted_metal_white"))

        # Door observation window
        win_w = door_w * 0.45
        win_h = door_h * 0.50
        win_geom = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        w_verts = [v for v in win_geom["verts"] if isinstance(v, bmesh.types.BMVert)]
        for v in w_verts:
            v.co.x *= win_w
            v.co.y *= door_t * 1.2
            v.co.z *= win_h
            v.co = door_rot.to_matrix() @ v.co
            v.co += door_center + door_rot.to_matrix() @ mathutils.Vector((0.0, 0.0, cabin_h * 0.08))

        for f in bm.faces:
            if all(v in w_verts for v in f.verts):
                MeshBuilder.apply_face_attributes(f, glass_mat, glass_rgba, col_layer)
                MeshBuilder.apply_face_uv_rect(f, uv_layer, PS1TextureAtlas.get_rect("glass_reinforced"))

        # 6. External cycle control panel on side wall
        if self.config.has_external_cycle_panel:
            panel_x = w / 2.0 + 0.03
            panel_z = cabin_z + 0.10
            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm,
                size=(0.06, 0.22, 0.32),
                offset=(panel_x, 0.15, panel_z),
                mat_idx=metal_mat,
                rgba=metal_rgba,
                uv_rect=PS1TextureAtlas.get_rect("metal_dark_grime")
            )
            # Cycle status screen
            if self.config.cycle_state == "active":
                scr_rect = PS1TextureAtlas.get_rect("oxygen_cyan_glow")
                scr_rgba = (0.2, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0)
            elif self.config.cycle_state == "alarm":
                scr_rect = PS1TextureAtlas.get_rect("led_red")
                scr_rgba = (0.9, 0.15, 0.15, 1.0)
            else:
                scr_rect = PS1TextureAtlas.get_rect("crt_screen_green")
                scr_rgba = (0.1, 0.85, 0.25, 1.0)

            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm,
                size=(0.01, 0.16, 0.12),
                offset=(panel_x + 0.031, 0.15, panel_z + 0.06),
                mat_idx=screen_mat,
                rgba=scr_rgba,
                uv_rect=scr_rect
            )

        self.finalize_mesh(obj, bm)
        self.compact_materials(obj)
        return obj

import math
import mathutils
import bmesh
import bpy
import random
from typing import Optional

from ...core.base_generator import BaseAssetGenerator
from ...core.materials import MaterialManager
from ...core.mesh_builder import MeshBuilder
from .config import DoorConfig

class DoorGenerator(BaseAssetGenerator[DoorConfig]):
    """Procedural generator for industrial doors, airlocks and emergency bulkheads (PSX low-poly)."""

    def generate(self, config: DoorConfig) -> bpy.types.Object:
        self.clean_context()
        rng = random.Random(config.seed)

        self.material_manager = self.get_material_manager(config)
        mesh_name = f"{config.name}_mesh"
        obj_name = config.name

        if obj_name in bpy.data.objects:
            bpy.data.objects.remove(bpy.data.objects[obj_name], do_unlink=True)
        if mesh_name in bpy.data.meshes:
            bpy.data.meshes.remove(bpy.data.meshes[mesh_name], do_unlink=True)

        mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new(mesh_name)
        obj = bpy.data.objects.new(obj_name, mesh)
        bpy.context.collection.objects.link(obj)

        self.material_manager.assign_to_mesh(obj)
        m_idx = self.material_manager.material_indices
        rgba = {k: self.material_manager.get_rgba(k) for k in self.material_manager.palette.keys()}

        bm = bmesh.new()
        col_layer = bm.loops.layers.color.new("Color")

        frame_w = config.width
        frame_h = config.height
        frame_d = config.frame_depth
        thick = config.frame_thickness

        if config.door_type == "emergency_bulkhead":
            door_mat = "door_emergency_red"
        elif config.door_type == "heavy_airlock":
            door_mat = "casing"
        else:
            door_mat = "door_frame_heavy"

        # 1. Outer Bulkhead Frame (Left jamb, Right jamb, Header)
        left_jamb_x = -(frame_w / 2.0) + (thick / 2.0)
        MeshBuilder.add_box(
            bm=bm,
            size=mathutils.Vector((thick, frame_h, frame_d)),
            offset=mathutils.Vector((left_jamb_x, frame_h / 2.0, 0.0)),
            mat_idx=m_idx.get("door_frame_heavy", 0),
            rgba=rgba.get("door_frame_heavy", (0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 1.0)),
            color_layer=col_layer
        )
        right_jamb_x = (frame_w / 2.0) - (thick / 2.0)
        MeshBuilder.add_box(
            bm=bm,
            size=mathutils.Vector((thick, frame_h, frame_d)),
            offset=mathutils.Vector((right_jamb_x, frame_h / 2.0, 0.0)),
            mat_idx=m_idx.get("door_frame_heavy", 0),
            rgba=rgba.get("door_frame_heavy", (0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 1.0)),
            color_layer=col_layer
        )
        header_y = frame_h - (thick / 2.0)
        MeshBuilder.add_box(
            bm=bm,
            size=mathutils.Vector((frame_w, thick, frame_d * 1.08)),
            offset=mathutils.Vector((0.0, header_y, 0.0)),
            mat_idx=m_idx.get("door_frame_heavy", 0),
            rgba=rgba.get("door_frame_heavy", (0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 1.0)),
            color_layer=col_layer
        )

        # 2. Dual Sliding Door Leaves (Left and Right)
        inner_w = frame_w - (2.0 * thick)
        inner_h = frame_h - thick
        leaf_w = (inner_w / 2.0) + 0.03
        leaf_h = inner_h
        leaf_d = frame_d * 0.22

        max_slide = (inner_w / 2.0) * 0.95
        slide_x = config.open_ratio * max_slide

        left_leaf_x = -(leaf_w / 2.0) - slide_x
        MeshBuilder.add_box(
            bm=bm,
            size=mathutils.Vector((leaf_w, leaf_h, leaf_d)),
            offset=mathutils.Vector((left_leaf_x, leaf_h / 2.0, 0.0)),
            mat_idx=m_idx.get(door_mat, 0),
            rgba=rgba.get(door_mat, (0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 1.0)),
            color_layer=col_layer
        )
        right_leaf_x = (leaf_w / 2.0) + slide_x
        MeshBuilder.add_box(
            bm=bm,
            size=mathutils.Vector((leaf_w, leaf_h, leaf_d)),
            offset=mathutils.Vector((right_leaf_x, leaf_h / 2.0, 0.0)),
            mat_idx=m_idx.get(door_mat, 0),
            rgba=rgba.get(door_mat, (0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 1.0)),
            color_layer=col_layer
        )

        # Reinforcing ribs across door leaves
        for rib_y in (leaf_h * 0.25, leaf_h * 0.50, leaf_h * 0.75):
            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm=bm,
                size=mathutils.Vector((leaf_w * 0.88, 0.05, leaf_d + 0.02)),
                offset=mathutils.Vector((left_leaf_x, rib_y, 0.0)),
                mat_idx=m_idx.get("casing", 0),
                rgba=rgba.get("casing", (0.15, 0.15, 0.15, 1.0)),
                color_layer=col_layer
            )
            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm=bm,
                size=mathutils.Vector((leaf_w * 0.88, 0.05, leaf_d + 0.02)),
                offset=mathutils.Vector((right_leaf_x, rib_y, 0.0)),
                mat_idx=m_idx.get("casing", 0),
                rgba=rgba.get("casing", (0.15, 0.15, 0.15, 1.0)),
                color_layer=col_layer
            )

        # 3. Reinforced Viewport Window (Allows seeing Europa / adjacent room)
        if config.has_reinforced_window:
            win_y = leaf_h * 0.62
            win_w = leaf_w * 0.38
            win_h = 0.25
            for lx in (left_leaf_x, right_leaf_x):
                # Window Frame
                MeshBuilder.add_box(
                    bm=bm,
                    size=mathutils.Vector((win_w, win_h, leaf_d + 0.03)),
                    offset=mathutils.Vector((lx, win_y, 0.0)),
                    mat_idx=m_idx.get("switch_base", 0),
                    rgba=rgba.get("switch_base", (0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 1.0)),
                    color_layer=col_layer
                )
                # Glass insert
                MeshBuilder.add_box(
                    bm=bm,
                    size=mathutils.Vector((win_w * 0.8, win_h * 0.75, leaf_d + 0.035)),
                    offset=mathutils.Vector((lx, win_y, 0.0)),
                    mat_idx=m_idx.get("glass_tube", 0),
                    rgba=rgba.get("glass_tube", (0.2, 0.4, 0.5, 1.0)),
                    color_layer=col_layer
                )

        # 4. Hydraulic / Pneumatic Actuator Pistons Above Door
        if config.has_hydraulic_pistons:
            piston_y = header_y + (thick * 0.15)
            for side in (-1.0, 1.0):
                px = side * (inner_w * 0.35)
                MeshBuilder.add_cylinder(
                    bm=bm,
                    radius=0.035,
                    depth=inner_w * 0.45,
                    segments=5,
                    offset=mathutils.Vector((px, piston_y, frame_d * 0.4)),
                    axis='X',
                    mat_idx=m_idx.get("switch_metal", 0),
                    rgba=rgba.get("switch_metal", (0.7, 0.7, 0.7, 1.0)),
                    color_layer=col_layer,
                    smooth=False
                )

        # 5. Top Hazard Chevrons / Header Trim
        if config.has_hazard_stripes:
            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm=bm,
                size=mathutils.Vector((inner_w * 0.95, 0.06, (frame_d * 1.08) + 0.01)),
                offset=mathutils.Vector((0.0, header_y - (thick * 0.35), 0.0)),
                mat_idx=m_idx.get("hazard_yellow", 0),
                rgba=rgba.get("hazard_yellow", (0.85, 0.62, 0.08, 1.0)),
                color_layer=col_layer
            )

        # 6. Status Light Bar
        if config.has_status_light:
            if config.open_ratio > 0.4:
                light_color = "led_green"
            elif config.door_type == "emergency_bulkhead":
                light_color = "door_emergency_red"
            else:
                light_color = "led_yellow"

            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm=bm,
                size=mathutils.Vector((0.22, 0.045, (frame_d * 1.08) + 0.02)),
                offset=mathutils.Vector((0.0, header_y + 0.02, 0.0)),
                mat_idx=m_idx.get(light_color, 0),
                rgba=rgba.get(light_color, (0.2, 0.9, 0.2, 1.0)),
                color_layer=col_layer
            )

        # 7. Access Control Interface
        if config.access_interface == "card_reader":
            reader_pos = mathutils.Vector((right_jamb_x, frame_h * 0.48, (frame_d / 2.0) + 0.02))
            MeshBuilder.add_box(
                bm=bm,
                size=mathutils.Vector((thick * 0.65, 0.18, 0.04)),
                offset=reader_pos,
                mat_idx=m_idx.get("casing_inner", 0),
                rgba=rgba.get("casing_inner", (0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 1.0)),
                color_layer=col_layer
            )
            MeshBuilder.add_cylinder(
                bm=bm,
                radius=0.012,
                depth=0.015,
                segments=4,
                offset=mathutils.Vector((reader_pos.x, reader_pos.y + 0.05, reader_pos.z + 0.02)),
                axis='Z',
                mat_idx=m_idx.get("led_green", 0),
                rgba=rgba.get("led_green", (0.1, 0.9, 0.2, 1.0)),
                color_layer=col_layer,
                smooth=False
            )
        elif config.access_interface == "manual_wheel":
            # Big wheel on left leaf
            wheel_pos = mathutils.Vector((left_leaf_x, leaf_h * 0.5, leaf_d + 0.04))
            MeshBuilder.add_cylinder(
                bm=bm,
                radius=0.18,
                depth=0.03,
                segments=6,
                offset=wheel_pos,
                axis='Z',
                mat_idx=m_idx.get("valve_red", 0),
                rgba=rgba.get("valve_red", (0.8, 0.1, 0.1, 1.0)),
                color_layer=col_layer,
                smooth=False
            )

        bm.to_mesh(mesh)
        bm.free()
        mesh.update()
        return obj
